dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures display high-contrast, jagged perimeters. The visual gradient transitions from a dark exterior background to a high-intensity, lighter-pixel ring structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels lacking internal gradients are concentrated in high density along the lower anterior and posterior lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the primary macro-annuli form a series of interconnected irregular triangles and a central pentagonal relationship across the upper lateral plane.
